text:
Palladium Price in 1996
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1996, the LBMA palladium price fell 8.8% between 1996-01-31 ($128) and 1996-12-30 ($117). The highest sampled price was $139 in March and the lowest was $115 in November. The mean of these observations was $127. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
